values.note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults before tax (6% tax on top), October 2026: FULL HOOK-UP GRAVEL SITE $50, FULL HOOK-UP WATERFRONT $55, Tuesday and Saturday alike. These are the cheapest types Campspot offers to a Motorhome: WATER, ELECTRIC, GREYWATER ($45, to 32 ft) lists fifth-wheels, travel trailers, truck campers and vans but not motorhomes, and WATER AN ELECTRIC ONLY ($40) is for rigs to 20 ft. No booking fee shown. Read 2026-10-13.

values.note: Campspot lists 11 RV sites: 4 full-hookup gravel (to 37 ft, pull-through), 3 full-hookup waterfront (to 36 ft), 3 water/electric/greywater (to 32 ft, not offered to motorhomes) and 1 water/electric (to 20 ft); plus a primitive tent site, a rental camper and a cabin.
Campspot's last entered closure ran 2025-10-19 to 2026-05-20; late in the season it takes no Monday-Wednesday arrivals or departures.

summary: No operator website exists; Campspot is the park's only page (phone 269-330-4860 matches). Changed fees base $45 -> $50: the $45 water/electric/greywater type is not offered to motorhomes, so the cheapest Motorhome type is the $50 full-hookup gravel site ($55 waterfront). Added max rig 37 ft, pull-throughs, season (closed in winter), confirmed water/sewer and Campspot booking. Electric amperage left unknown (the note's '110-volt plug on a 30-amp breaker' is not a hookup rating).
flags: Website: no operator site found. Presence passes on the Campspot booking engine with phone 269-330-4860 and reviews into August 2026.

Price gate: base is exactly US$50 (full-hookup gravel, the cheapest type Campspot offers to a motorhome) before 6% tax; not over the line, but at it. The $45 water/electric/greywater type excludes motorhomes. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Grand Rapids 110 km); the family has not stayed here.
